question: The value of sqrt{196} + sqrt{0.0256} - sqrt{7.29} is _____.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Identify the perfect squares directly: 196 = 14², 256 = 16², 729 = 27².

Adjust the decimal places: 4 places in 0.0256 → 2 places in root → 0.16.

Adjust the decimal places: 2 places in 7.29 → 1 place in root → 2.7.

Substitute directly: 14 + 0.16 − 2.7 = 14.16 − 2.7 = 11.46.

**∴ The correct answer is 11.46.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Expression = √196 + √0.0256 − √7.29

**Calculations:**

⇒ First, resolve the square roots by converting the decimals into fractions.

⇒ √196 = 14

⇒ √0.0256 = √(256 ÷ 10000) = 16 ÷ 100 = 0.16

⇒ √7.29 = √(729 ÷ 100) = 27 ÷ 10 = 2.7

⇒ Now, substitute these evaluated values back into the expression.

⇒ Expression = 14 + 0.16 − 2.7

⇒ Expression = 14.16 − 2.7

⇒ Expression = 11.46

**∴ The correct answer is 11.46.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

BODMAS Rule

It dictates the standard sequence of calculations: Brackets, Orders (such as roots and powers), Division × Multiplication, and Addition − Subtraction.

Square Roots of Decimals

If a perfect square decimal has 2n decimal places, its square root will consistently have exactly n decimal places. Example: √0.0004 = 0.02.

Important Perfect Squares

Memorizing squares up to 30 speeds up simplification significantly. For instance, 24² = 576, 25² = 625, 26² = 676, and 27² = 729.
